failures.USER_OBSERVED: Engine existed but ad-hoc Python/HTML/ReportLab created artifacts.
failures.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Production must use authorized Drawing Engine.
failures.ROOT_CAUSE: Production artifact authority was non-exclusive and router/contract were advisory.
failures.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: Gates only applied when engine path was entered.

failures.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Presentation edits must never delete geometry-bearing source.
failures.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Destructive raster mutation had write authority over source pixels.
failures.ROOT_CAUSE: Raster presentation operation was not subordinate to immutable geometry authority.
failures.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: No mandatory pre-user historical geometry replay and bypass path skipped structured key-state validation.
failures.BYPASS_PATH: raster source -> destructive box mask -> artifact
failures.MISSING_ENFORCEMENT: forbidden production operation + immutable base overlay

failures.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Generative output could become the visible geometry layer.
failures.ROOT_CAUSE: AI presentation layer lacked a technical prohibition against replacing geometry authority.
failures.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: Source-lock principle was not an artifact-admission dependency.

failures.USER_OBSERVED: Rich mining still yielded generic layouts.
failures.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Reference DNA visibly changes engine parameters and output.
failures.ROOT_CAUSE: No compiler from mined DNA to measurable engine parameters and effect probes.
failures.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: Reference presence was confused with reference application.

failures.USER_OBSERVED: Source-preserved but weak output was treated as enhanced.
failures.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Fidelity and presentation quality must pass independently.
failures.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Source preservation could dominate completion semantics.
failures.ROOT_CAUSE: PASS semantics collapsed fidelity, clarity, reference effect and user effect.
failures.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: Quality gate lacked mandatory independent effect dimensions.

failures.USER_OBSERVED: User repeatedly found deleted geometry, wrong boxes/rotation and weak expression.
failures.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Result exposure could occur before complete validation.
failures.ROOT_CAUSE: No deny-by-default L8 user exposure gate.
failures.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: Validation was optional/bypassable and not a show permission.

failures.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Temporary code could become a production renderer.
failures.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: Fast execution preference lacked production boundary.

failures.USER_OBSERVED: Same-content PDF risked being marked stale due to modified time.
failures.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Timestamp could substitute for content comparison.
failures.ROOT_CAUSE: Metadata freshness and content change were conflated.

failures.USER_OBSERVED: ROAD/SOIL/GROUND risked being inferred from color/topology.
failures.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Presentation could run ahead of semantic verification.
failures.ROOT_CAUSE: Semantic proposal state was not always coupled to production exposure permission.
failures.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: Existing semantic rules could be bypassed by alternate renderer.

failures.USER_OBSERVED: Claims such as perfect privacy/daylight/south orientation/penthouse risked exceeding evidence.
failures.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Narrative evidence gate was not guaranteed at final exposure.
failures.ROOT_CAUSE: Narrative validation was not a conditional dependency of production admission.
failures.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: Later-added protocol did not own show permission.

failures.USER_OBSERVED: Bad architecture could be faithfully resumed.
failures.ROOT_CAUSE: RESUME and RETROSPECTIVE/SURGERY modes were not explicit peers.
failures.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: Recovery package did not encode permission to supersede bad structure.

failures.USER_OBSERVED: Drawing Engine existed on a feature branch, while the same PR accumulated Hannam-specific report/profile/task/handoff artifacts.
failures.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Generic engine availability is a promoted runtime capability; project packs stay isolated and cannot define engine authority.
failures.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Feature-branch implementation and project-specific assets were co-located, making 'engine exists' ambiguous and default routing non-authoritative.
failures.ROOT_CAUSE: Implementation promotion state and domain ownership were not part of engine availability semantics.
failures.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: Router/gates validated execution after entry but did not prove that the engine was the promoted default capability nor that its package was project-neutral.
failures.BYPASS_PATH: feature branch engine exists -> task runs elsewhere / local workaround; or broad project branch -> proposed central merge
failures.DESTINATION: engine promotion registry + split integration PR
